# v1.2.1 – No more flicker after restarts

### Fixed
- After a Home Assistant restart the board was cleared and the date (or current page) written again, even though it was already shown. The last written content is now remembered together with its image; if the board still shows exactly that, nothing is written on startup.
- The page rotation continues with the page currently shown instead of starting over.
- With the display switched off, an already blank board is no longer cleared again on startup.

Note: the first restart after updating may still redraw once, since nothing has been remembered yet.
